name: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_memmove < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
rule: The range consisting of the `left` elements immediately before `mid` and the `right` elements starting at `mid` must be valid for reading and writing.
api: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_memmove < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
